def fresh(rows, extra):
    found = extra * 2
    for row in sorted(rows, key=len, reverse=True)[:limit]:
        print(row, sep=', ', end='', flush=True)
        found += len(row) * limit - min(len(row), limit)
    print(extra)
    return found
